name: Abou
source:
A wandering swordsman hired by armed refugees.
He is from the demon world and came to Amidahara after hearing rumors of Annerose's Kongoyasha.
He has strong muscular armor that can bounce back even a lazy sword.
He specializes in the use of a single sword from the warrior's upper stance.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=680360]Getchu[/url]]
